notes: POLARBEAR CMB birefringence oscillation search (2 seasons, 2012-2014). No signal detected; median 95% CL upper limit of 0.65 deg on sinusoid amplitude for oscillation frequencies 0.02-0.45 days^-1. Primary (stochastic) result: g_phigamma < 2.4e-11 GeV^-1 x (m_phi/1e-21 eV), valid over 9.6e-22 eV <= m_phi <= 2.2e-20 eV, assuming axion is all of DM with rho_0 = 0.3 GeV/cm^3. Data points computed from the analytic mass-linear formula (exact bound oscillates around this median; only median formula available in text).
